name: tools-spc-converter-for-musescore
title: SPC Converter for MuseScore
description:
SPC Converter for MuseScore is a plugin for the open source notation software MuseScore. It allows you to write a score in musical notation using MuseScore, then export it as a text file which can be compiled by AddMusicK and inserted into an SMW romhack.

For a full description of how to use the tool, please see the readme included in the *.zip file (also available in the linked repository on GitLab).
